plan.scope: All eight cells with baseline/candidate/reconstructed vLLM; quiet and diagnostic attempts separate
plan.sampling: greedy temperature0, original EOS and original request max_tokens
plan.exclusion_policy: none; fail whole attempt, retain every sample and failed attempt
plan.correctness_policy: Riley exact frozen token/text/finish reference; all engine input/output counts and transport exact; cross-engine arithmetic differences recorded
post_screen_required: independent raw replay and all-cell comparison
plan.host_gate_revision_reason: Diagnostic only: record3 prephase observations and truthful quiet flag; do not abort solely on pressure; retain every measured row including slow rows. No pooling with admission-controlled attempts.
plan.host_pressure_policy: selected explicit mode; quiet requires original gate; diagnostic observes all and cannot qualify
plan.startup_timeout_scope: cold initialization only; captured logs and host samples; excluded from serving timing by explicit warmup and retained phase envelopes
plan.execution_state: predeclared before launch; native816 and HTTP60 completed; performance unrun
